ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.35:0.65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) central peduncle and tip regions; expansive high-intensity (white) mottling concentrated in the mid-lobe regions, with the left lobe exhibiting a more continuous white patch at the lower boundary compared to the more fragmented mottling on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 145 degrees and a narrow interior vertical cleft.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (ragged edge) extending from the notch to the fluke tips; amplitude of variations increases significantly at the distal 15% of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature transition from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-tilted corners.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white circular ring-shaped clusters (rosettes) measuring approximately 10-30 pixels in diameter, primarily located within the dark pigmented regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint dark linear disruptions present in the lower-left white quadrant, oriented diagonally toward the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacles (likely acorn/stalked) localized on the outer distal edges of both the left and right fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptional frequency of circular scarring ('cookie-cutter' style marks) creating a 'dotted' texture across the dark pigmentation zones.
